trust_ladder_rules.rule_name: Trust Encoding - Lower Display Year Means Higher Trust (Canonical)
trust_ladder_rules.normative_text: Canonical or verified filesystem memory paths SHOULD use the display year segment (actual_calendar_year minus 1000) under .../canonical/ so trusted material sorts before staging. Staging paths use the actual calendar year segment. Application logic and PK bands follow CHRONOLOGICAL_TRUST_LADDER doctrine.
trust_ladder_rules.do_not_fix_warning: 1026 is not a calendar typo for 2026 in canonical tier encoding. Do not mass-replace 1026 with 2026 in canonical memory_key paths for new verified content.
trust_ladder_rules.violation_consequence: Canonical content could sort after staging or confuse trust tier, breaking ladder semantics.
